name: plugin.bigquery_augmented_analytics
description: BigQuery in-database augmented analytics TVF execution for anomaly detection, change point isolation, Apriori attribution, and ARIMA_PLUS causal lift
author: Brain Harness

entrypoints.name: bigquery_temporal_profile
entrypoints.description: Execute Stage 1 Temporal Profiling via ML.TREND and ML.SEASONALITY BigQuery TVFs

parameters.name: seasonalities
parameters.description: Optional list of seasonality periods (e.g. WEEKLY, MONTHLY)

entrypoints.name: bigquery_detect_change_points
entrypoints.description: Execute Stage 2 Structural Shift Isolation via ML.DETECT_CHANGE_POINTS BigQuery TVF

parameters.name: min_probability
parameters.description: Minimum Bayesian change point probability threshold (default: 0.95)

entrypoints.name: bigquery_attribute_drivers
entrypoints.description: Execute Stage 3 Combinatorial Attribution via AI.KEY_DRIVERS Apriori BigQuery TVF

parameters.name: dimension_cols
parameters.description: List of categorical dimension columns to evaluate

parameters.name: interest_condition
parameters.description: SQL boolean filter defining the interest period cohort

parameters.name: top_k
parameters.description: Top K driver segments to return (default: 20)

entrypoints.name: bigquery_causal_lift
entrypoints.description: Execute Stage 4 Counterfactual Impact Modeling via AI.CAUSAL_EFFECT ARIMA_PLUS BigQuery TVF

parameters.name: output_time_series
parameters.description: Whether to return daily trajectory points with confidence bounds

entrypoints.name: bigquery_augmented_pipeline
entrypoints.description: Execute complete 5-Stage BigQuery Augmented Analytics pipeline end-to-end

parameters.name: dimension_cols
parameters.description: List of categorical dimension columns to evaluate

parameters.name: intervention_timestamp
parameters.description: Optional intervention timestamp (if omitted, isolated dynamically from change points)

parameters.name: top_k
parameters.description: Top K driver segments to return

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: Whether to execute in mock dry-run mode without live BigQuery connection

entrypoints.name: bigquery_visual_brief
entrypoints.description: Generate interactive HTML visual brief with Tailwind and Mermaid TVF DAG

parameters.name: output_path
parameters.description: Optional path to save HTML visual brief
